title: Send a signed-out visitor to /journeys/mine, /journeys/library, /journeys/new or /practices/new to sign-in, not a Discover 404

source.ref: Visual sweep 2026-11-02, signed-out render at 1280 and 390: /journeys/library, /journeys/mine, /journeys/new and /practices/new all landed on the 'We couldn't find that' page

detail:
The public-twin table maps /journeys/<slug> to /discover/journeys/<slug> (and /practices/<id> to its twin) with a one-segment pattern, and the (main) layout's signed-out branch redirects there. The member pages one segment under those prefixes (journeys/library, journeys/mine, journeys/new, practices/new; circles/new, circles/starter, circles/templates go through the lookup rule) matched as if they were slugs, so a share or email link to them dead-ended on a Discover 404 for anyone signed out. Fix: a RESERVED_SEGMENTS set in matchPublicTwin returns no twin for those names, so proxy.ts keeps them protected and bounces to /sign-in with next=<the page>. Entity slugs still twin; the vitest file covers both.

 Fixed 2026-11-02; curl on the branch: /journeys/mine signed out 307s to /sign-in?next=%2Fjourneys%2Fmine.
